documents.title: path-read
documents.text: Path.read_text(encoding=None, errors=None) opens a file, returns its text as a string and closes the file. Set encoding="utf-8" when reading a UTF-8 file.

chunks.text: Path.read_text(encoding=None, errors=None) opens a file, returns its text as a string and closes the file. Set encoding="utf-8" when reading a UTF-8 file.

documents.title: path-read-3-13
documents.text: In Python 3.13, Path.read_text accepts encoding, errors and newline. The newline parameter was added in Python 3.13. The method returns decoded file text and closes the file.

documents.title: path-write
documents.fact_status: original summary retained; appended explicitly synthetic length padding, not official documentation
documents.text:
Path.write_text(data, encoding=None, errors=None, newline=None) writes text to a file and closes it. Set encoding="utf-8" to select UTF-8. An existing file is overwritten. The method returns the number of characters written.
